image_description: A close-up, eye-level shot of a Dungeness crab (Cancer magister). The image focuses on the anterior portion, highlighting the broad, reddish-brown carapace and two large, robust chelipeds (claws) extended forward. The claws show characteristic white/cream coloring on the inner surfaces and red tips. Multiple walking legs are visible extending laterally from beneath the carapace on both sides. The eyes are visible on short stalks at the front margin. The background is a blurred, warm-toned surface.
